items.question: What condition of death and splendor arises for that accomplished practitioner?

items.inference: The practitioner becomes free from death and possesses imperishable immortal splendor.
items.plain_english: For him there is no death; indeed, his splendor becomes imperishable and immortal.

items.plain_english: But when angered, O Goddess, he can shake the three worlds with all that moves and does not move.
